capabilities: . Create companion notes beside source files
. Allow manual enrichment of generated notes
extras: Desktop-only; does not support automatic conversion, AI-generated enrichment, or mobile platforms.
problem: Users often have raw, unstructured transcript files that require manual processing to be useful within a knowledge base.
summary: Soundings converts raw transcript files (.txt, .vtt, .srt) into structured Markdown notes beside the original source file.
